web.title: New Gemini app features, available to try at no cost
web.description:
# New Gemini app features, available to try at no cost
- The Gemini app is getting a bunch of new features, including Deep Research and personalization.
- Deep Research is now available for everyone to try and helps you research and synthesize information from the web.

## Deep Research is even smarter, rolling out for everyone to try
Today, we're upgrading Deep Research with Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental. Gemini now shows its thoughts while it browses the web, giving you a real-time look into how it’s going about solving your research task.
